name: Aiman Zulkifli
bio:
Aiman's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Sepang International Circuit with his father, a race engineer. Witnessing the intricate ballet of logistics behind the scenes fueled his ambition to contribute beyond just spectating. After completing a diploma in logistics management, he landed an internship with a local racing team, quickly proving his organizational skills and proactive approach. 

Now at Racing Bulls, Aiman thrives under pressure, meticulously coordinating the movement of equipment and personnel. He's known for his ability to anticipate potential delays and implement contingency plans, ensuring seamless operations at every race. His calm demeanor and unwavering reliability make him an invaluable asset to the team, consistently going the extra mile to ensure everything runs smoothly. He has a particular interest in the sustainability side of logistics, and is always looking for innovative ways to reduce the team's carbon footprint.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade
physical.description: Aiman has a lean build and a focused expression, often seen sporting a Racing Bulls cap.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool on his belt, even in the office.
Categorizes his snack stash by expiration date.
Has a habit of speaking in logistical acronyms, sometimes confusing his colleagues.
